D_license_or_terms.output_storage: CLEAR under the separate DeepSeek Open Platform Terms of Service (governs API outputs specifically, distinct from the HF weight license) -- see teacher/distillation clause below, which assigns output rights/title/interest to the user.
D_license_or_terms.synthetic_data_use: CLEAR -- covered by the same ToS §4.2 grant.
D_license_or_terms.distillation_teacher_use: EXPLICITLY PERMITTED -- DeepSeek Open Platform Terms of Service (https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-open-platform-terms-of-service.html) §4.2 states verbatim: 'You may apply the Inputs and Outputs of the Services to a wide range of use cases, including personal use, academic research, derivative product development, training other models (such as model distillation), etc.' This is the strongest, most explicit teacher-use permission found among all six references this phase -- it names 'model distillation' directly, not inferred from silence or a general permissive grant.

E_reference_evaluation_admission.rationale: Identity resolved, license MIT (unambiguously CLEAR for evaluation use), evidence retention permitted (ToS §4.2 output-rights assignment), no access-path blocker.

F_evidence_retention.rationale: DeepSeek Open Platform ToS §4.2: 'We assign any rights, title, and interests -- if any -- in the Outputs of the Services to you,' consistent with retaining prompts/outputs/metadata as durable internal evaluation evidence.

G_output_display_to_judges.rationale: Same ToS §4.2 output-rights assignment; MIT weight license imposes no display restriction either.

H_private_holdout_compatibility.rationale: No holdout prompts authored this phase. Nothing in the MIT license or the fetched ToS §4.2 requires publication or prohibits confidential internal test material.

I_automated_evaluation_allowed.rationale: No clause explicitly naming 'benchmarking' or 'automated evaluation' was found in the fetched ToS text -- not prohibited, but the broad §4.2 grant ('a wide range of use cases... derivative product development') was not read as an unambiguous, name-specific authorization either. Recorded as unresolved rather than assumed.

J_commercial_product_evaluation_allowed.rationale: MIT license places no restriction on commercial use, and ToS §4.2's broad use-case grant covers derivative product development.

first_party_api.free_tier: NOT DOCUMENTED on the pricing page fetched
first_party_api.rate_limits: Concurrency limit 2500 for deepseek-flash (per api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/rate_limit); capacity-expansion requests available at no extra cost.
first_party_api.context_limit: 1,048,576 tokens input, up to 384K max output
first_party_api.automated_benchmarking_tos: Not explicitly named -- see I above.

K_access_paths.access_preflight_rationale: The first-party API is a documented, official, OpenAI-compatible, model-identity-exposing path with clear terms -- but it is a paid, metered product with no confirmed free tier, so any future call requires a fresh zero-cash feasibility check before execution.

L_zero_owner_cash_rationale: DeepSeek's official API pricing (even at off-peak cache-hit rates) is a real, non-zero cost per token with no documented free tier. No live billing check performed or authorized this phase.
M_rate_limit_quota_implications: Concurrency limit 2500 (generous relative to other references' documented limits, e.g. deepseek-v4-pro's 500) -- would not itself be a practical blocker for a bounded evaluation run, cost remains the primary constraint.
N_reproducibility_limitations: Open-weight pin is fixed (FIXED_IMMUTABLE) -- strong reproducibility for model identity. Off-peak/peak pricing tiers do not affect model behavior, only cost -- no reproducibility impact from that. Thinking mode must be explicitly recorded per future call.
O_mutable_api_identity_requirements: NOT_APPLICABLE -- OPEN_WEIGHT reference with a fixed immutable revision.

P_teacher_distillation_synthetic_data_ri.rationale: DeepSeek Open Platform ToS §4.2 explicitly names 'training other models (such as model distillation)' as a permitted use case of API Inputs and Outputs -- the strongest, most direct teacher/distillation permission evidence found among the six references. This is independent of, and does not conflate with, the reference-evaluation-admission decision above (§10) -- both happen to be ADMITTED here because the evidence for each was independently found sufficient.
